### utmctl --attach probe + default-drive shape — UTM 4.7.5 / macOS 26.6.2 / 2026-09-08T17:42:44Z
# Every run below records stdout and stderr separately and the real exit status of
# utmctl itself (no pipeline, no 2>&1), plus wall-clock seconds.

## 1. app handshake
$ open -a UTM; until utmctl version >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; utmctl version
4.7.5
exit=0

## 2. create a VM with NO `drives` key at all
$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM" to make new virtual machine with properties {backend:qemu, configuration:{name:"wargame-t1-attach2", architecture:"aarch64", memory:1024, cpu cores:1}}'
E4698D94-6FBC-4665-AB87-EDC65F463A94 wargame-t1-attach2
exit=0

$ osascript applescript/show-drives.applescript wargame-t1-attach2
drives (2):
  [1] id=73DA22FF-B99C-4842-926E-45CD98F102A0 removable=true iface=USB hostMiB=0
  [2] id=ACB23102-DE86-41CB-BEE3-F0FCA3F30482 removable=false iface=VirtIO hostMiB=0

exit=0

## 3. the generated QEMU command line for that driveless VM
$ utmctl status wargame-t1-attach2
started

$ ps -Aww -o command | grep qemu-aarch64-softmmu | grep -v grep | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -E 'media=cdrom|media=disk|usb-storage|virtio-blk'
usb-storage,drive=drive73DA22FF-B99C-4842-926E-45CD98F102A0,removable=true,bootindex=0,bus=usb-bus.0
if=none,media=cdrom,id=drive73DA22FF-B99C-4842-926E-45CD98F102A0,readonly=on
virtio-blk-pci,drive=driveACB23102-DE86-41CB-BEE3-F0FCA3F30482,serial=ACB23102DE8641CBBEE3,bootindex=1
if=none,media=disk,id=driveACB23102-DE86-41CB-BEE3-F0FCA3F30482,file.filename=/Users/moreal/Library/Containers/com.utmapp.UTM/Data/Documents/wargame-t1-attach2.utm/Data/ACB23102-DE86-41CB-BEE3-F0FCA3F30482.qcow2,discard=unmap,detect-zeroes=unmap
exit=0
# -> UTM adds a removable CD with NO file.filename plus a blank qcow2, unasked.

## 4. `utmctl attach` on the RUNNING VM

## 6. cleanup
$ utmctl list
UUID                                 Status   Name
E4698D94-6FBC-4665-AB87-EDC65F463A94 stopped  wargame-t1-attach2

$ utmctl list | tail -n +2 | while read; do case name in wargame-t1*) utmctl delete <uuid>;; *) skip;; esac; done
deleted E4698D94-6FBC-4665-AB87-EDC65F463A94 (wargame-t1-attach2)

$ utmctl list
UUID                                 Status   Name

$ pgrep -lf 'qemu-(aarch64|x86_64)-softmmu'

# ANOMALY, recorded for completeness and NOT reproduced by the three runs above:
# on 2026-09-09 at ~02:27 UTC+9, two `timeout 15 utmctl start <vm> --attach </dev/null`
# invocations against a different VM (wargame-t1-attach) instead ran the full 15 s and were
# killed by the timeout (exit 124) having written 0 bytes to both streams. Both happened
# while that VM had an orphaned QEMU process holding its efi_vars.fd (see
# orphan-qemu-process.txt), i.e. in the wedged-app situation of trap T8. Treat the 2 s /
# exit 0 behaviour above as the normal one and the block as another face of T8.
